Armaldo

Rock Bug

Hoenn · Generation 3

Armaldo is a Rock/Bug-type Plate Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 1.5 m tall and weighs 68.2 kg. It evolves from Anorith. Its highest base stat is Attack (125), with a base stat total of 495.
